$header_note: QPB v1.5.7 round-2 bug-hunting plan — 4 NEW repos following the proven copilot+codex success pattern from harness_runs/20260531T234613Z (where copilot/gpt-5.4 + codex/gpt-5.4-Mode-B produced 11 verified bugs across sidekiq + Newtonsoft.Json). **2026-06-01 rebalance: copilot kept on zod only (small TS repo); Hangfire shifted to claude/opus; new claude/sonnet chi row added for broader claude coverage — driven by Microsoft's copilot usage-based billing and the heuristic 'copilot on small repos only'.** Four different domains likely to surface different bug classes: Hangfire (.NET BG jobs, similar success domain as sidekiq), zod (TypeScript schema validation, edge-case rich), akka (Scala actors, concurrency-heavy like sidekiq), chi (Go HTTP router, small surface for sonnet calibration). Branch defaults: Hangfire=main, zod=main, akka=main, chi=master. Concurrency: pool={claude:2, copilot:1, codex:1} — all 4 run in parallel after the v1.5.7 174 manifest-based pool model. Runtime bound by codex Mode B akka (~60-80 min based on sidekiq baseline). Goal: expand the bug pile beyond the current 11 candidates. All bugs found go through BUG_REPORT_WORKFLOW.md for upstream filing.

runs.description: Row 0 — claude/opus reviews Hangfire (.NET background-job processor, ref=main) via pip-local-wheel (Mode A). **2026-06-01 rebalance:** was copilot/gpt-5.4 pre-rebalance. Same domain as sidekiq (which produced 10 bugs under codex Mode B) but in C# instead of Ruby. Hangfire's retry/state-machine/extension logic is rich in edge cases; opus selected for capability on this surface.

Row 1 — copilot/gpt-5.4 reviews zod (TypeScript schema validation, ref=main) via npm-local-tgz (Mode A). zod's type-narrowing edge cases + parser combinator logic are a different bug class from .NET / Ruby — likely to surface validation contract mismatches, refinement edge cases, transform composition bugs. npm channel matches the TS ecosystem cleanly. zod is the smallest repo in the round-2 plan — copilot stays here under the post-rebalance 'copilot on small repos only' heuristic.

Row 2 — codex/gpt-5.4 reviews akka (Scala/Java actors, ref=main) via clone channel (Mode B). codex requires Mode B; sidekiq codex Mode B found 10 bugs. akka's actor model + ask pattern + supervision hierarchy is concurrency-heavy in the same family as sidekiq's job-queue / retry / state-management surface. Different language (Scala) increases the chance of finding different bug shapes than sidekiq's Ruby bugs.

Row 3 — claude/sonnet reviews chi (Go HTTP router, ref=master) via pip-local-wheel (Mode A). **2026-06-01 rebalance addition:** broadens claude coverage on a small Go repo to balance the copilot-cost rebalance. chi is the smallest repo in the plan; sonnet is the right size match for the surface area. Go ecosystem + HTTP routing edge cases (middleware chain, context propagation, route conflicts).
